Interstate Road Transport Legislation (Repeal) Bill 2018 - Second Reading - Address emissions

The Interstate Road Transport Legislation (Repeal) Bill 2018 repeals the Federal Interstate Registration Scheme (FIRS), a 1987 scheme for heavy vehicles over 4.5 tonnes in interstate trade, which the speaker argued is now redundant due to improved jurisdictional cooperation and reforms, paving the way for a modern national registration system.
